text:
sam: heads-up discovered another invoice delta pattern - multi-hop proxies strip our runtime headers, so attribution falls back to ip-based heuristics and we get duplicate token charging.
izzy: ouch. any repro?
sam: customer t-789 uses an edge proxy that rewrites headers during scale events. we see usage events with `client_request_id` gone; only tokens+path left. duplicates across retries.
chao: is this the same symptom as the earlier rate_card miss or a different bug?
sam: related but different. pricing present, but we can't deterministically map requests to the originating session. billing dedupe uses request_id so it fails.
maria: we could require a short opaque `usage_id` header that clients sign with a local HMAC; if proxy rewrites, it should still pass along the small id. cheaper than full JWT.
izzy: makes sense. what about backwards compatibility for old SDKs and private deploys?
chao: plan: accept optional `x-rw-usage-id` header. if present, use for dedupe. if absent, fallback to existing heuristics. rollout via SDK patch and server-side permissive parsing.
sam: also propose adding `usage_provenance` field to audit with values like `producer`, `proxy_rewrite`, `inferred`. helps ops triage.
maria: plus include a tiny checksum of key fields in the event: `sha1(tenant_id|timestamp|tokens)` to detect accidental duplication from retries. not a crypto requirement, just collision avoidance.
izzy: small note: checksums add CPU in ingest path. can we make checksum optional via feature flag and only enabled in canary?
chao: yes. ingest will compute checksum only if feature flag on and `x-rw-usage-id` missing. default off globally.
sam: backfill/reconcile: we should run a idempotent dedupe pass for last 14 days where duplicate checksums exist and mark extraneous events with `dedupe_action: suppressed` in billing-audit.
maria: SQL prototype: `WITH dup AS (SELECT tenant_id, checksum, count(*) c FROM raw_usage WHERE checksum IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tenant_id, checksum HAVING c>1) INSERT INTO billing_audit (...) SELECT ... FROM raw_usage JOIN dup USING (tenant_id, checksum) WHERE row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY tenant_id, checksum ORDER BY ts) > 1;` - will iterate carefully.
izzy: permissions: dedupe results touch billing tables, so require billing-admin approval and test harness.
chao: who owns rollout? izzy picks up SDK changes, sam will add ingress checksum flag and dedupe logic, maria will own audit schema and reconcile job. I'll review PRs.
sam: timeline request: canary deploy in 2 weeks, full roll in 5 weeks. ok?
izzy: ok. I'll post SDK deprecations note and example for generating `x-rw-usage-id` (UUIDv4 or short base64 random).
maria: also add a small dashboard: `duplicate-rate` and `dedupe-suppressed-count` for canary window.
chao: add tests: fuzz proxy rewrite scenarios and a chaos test where header is dropped mid-flight.
izzy: done. i'll create the SDK PR and doc snippet.
sam: ping @metering-bot when canary scheduled so we can correlate.
metering-bot: metering-sim: canary scheduled 2026-04-09T05:00Z (mock).
sam: thanks. closing: non-blocking, additive headers, feature-flagged checksum and reconcile path.
